title: 第1365章 女王归来第1364章 还能复活两次
content_zh:
成堆的丹药如同江河倒灌般涌入他的口中，大大小小、形状各异、颜色不同的药丸混杂在一起，被他一口鲸吞入腹。
那些丹药的药性各不相同，有的温和，有的霸烈，有的清凉，有的灼热。
如此海量的丹药混杂在一起吞入腹中，换作任何一个正常的修士都会被那狂暴的药力炸得粉身碎骨、魂飞魄散。
但楚夏不在乎。
他有葬业之火。
暗金色的火焰在丹田中猛然燃起，将涌入腹中的丹药全部包裹在其中。
葬业之火疯狂炼化着那些丹药，将驳杂的药性提纯精炼，转化为最纯粹的能量注入经脉之中。
温和的药力顺着经脉流转全身，修复着被天道之力侵蚀的血肉。
霸道的药力在骨骼中奔腾咆哮，填补着骨骼上那些细密的裂纹。
清凉的药力涌入识海，安抚着被天道渗透搅得波动不断的灵魂。
灼热的药力冲入丹田，补充着混沌主宰之核消耗的主宰之力。
楚夏整个人的状态在丹药的补充下迅速回升。
消耗殆尽的力量重新充盈起来，受损的血肉重新恢复活力，破碎的骨骼重新变得坚固，波动的灵魂重新稳定下来。
而这一切，只用了短短一个呼吸的时间。
肯塔乌的复活还没有完成，楚夏已经重新恢复了战力。
他的嘴角浮起一丝冷冽的笑意，双腿猛然发力，整个人如同一道流星般朝着肯塔乌正在重聚的粒子群激射而去。
冰渊剑横在身前，剑锋上冰蓝色的光芒再次亮起。
这一次，他一定要打断肯塔乌的复活！
然而，就在楚夏即将冲到粒子群前的一瞬间，一道粗壮到极致的暗红色光柱从天而降，直直地轰在楚夏的头顶。
那不是灭世雷劫，而是一种更加纯粹、更加恐怖的天道攻击——天道本源光柱。

光柱中蕴含的天道之力已经浓郁到了无法用语言形容的程度，每一缕光芒都是天道的一次呼吸，每一次跳动都是法则的一次生灭。
光柱落下的瞬间，楚夏只觉得自己仿佛被整个世界正面撞击，整个人被光柱从空中直直地轰向地面。
轰！
楚夏的身体重重地砸在深坑底部，在地面上砸出了一个深不见底的人形坑洞。
他挣扎着想要爬起，但天道本源光柱并没有消散，而是持续不断地轰击着他的身体。
光柱中蕴含的天道之力如同无数把锋利的刀刃，在他的身体表面不断切割，每一刀都深可见骨。
群星闪耀套装的星光在疯狂闪烁，万倍防御加持运转到了极限，但依旧无法完全抵消天道本源光柱的伤害。
楚夏身上的血肉在光柱的轰击下不断被剥离，露出下方白森森的骨骼。
骨骼表面浮现出密密麻麻的裂纹，裂纹中透出微弱的星光，那是群星闪耀套装正在竭力维持着他的生机。
咔嚓！
一声清脆的断裂声响起。
楚夏的左臂骨骼在天道光柱的持续轰击下终于承受不住，从中间断成了两截。
断裂的骨骼刺破了皮肉，露出尖锐的断面，断面上的骨髓已经被天道之力蒸干，呈现出一种灰白的色泽。
楚夏闷哼一声，额头上青筋暴起，但牙齿却咬得更紧了。
他的右臂依旧死死握着冰渊剑，没有松手。
就在此时——
一只纤细的、白皙的、完美的如同艺术品般的玉手，忽然从楚夏身后伸了出来。
那只手轻飘飘地抬起来，修长的五指在虚空中轻轻一握。
那动作优雅而从容，带着一种说不清道不明的慵懒韵味，仿佛只是在随手拂去一片飘落在面前的落叶。
但就是这轻飘飘的一握，那恐怖到足以在瞬间毁灭九阶巅峰主宰者的天道本源光柱，便如同被一只无形的大手捏住般，轰然炸开。

光柱炸开后化作无数道细密的天道碎片，碎片在空中四散飞溅，如同烟花般绽放出璀璨的光芒。
content_en:
Piles of pills poured into his mouth like a river. Pills of various sizes, shapes, and colors were mixed together, and he swallowed them in one mouthful.
The medicinal properties of those elixirs are different, some are mild, some are powerful, some are cooling, and some are burning.
With such a large amount of pills mixed together and swallowed, any normal monk would be blown to pieces by the violent power of the medicine, and his soul would be blown away.
But Chu Xia didn't care.
He has a funeral fire.
Dark golden flames suddenly ignited in the Dantian, enveloping all the elixirs pouring into his belly.
The funeral fire was refining those elixirs crazily, purifying and refining the mixed medicinal properties, transforming them into the purest energy and injecting them into the meridians.
The gentle medicinal power flows throughout the body along the meridians, repairing the flesh and blood eroded by the power of heaven.
The overbearing medicinal power surges and roars in the bones, filling the fine cracks on the bones.
The cool medicinal power poured into the sea of ​​​​consciousness, soothing the soul that was disturbed by the penetration of heaven.
The scorching medicinal power rushes into the Dantian, replenishing the power of domination consumed by the core of the Chaos Domination.
Chu Xia's overall condition quickly recovered with the supplement of pills.
The exhausted strength was replenished, the damaged flesh and blood regained its vitality, the broken bones became strong again, and the fluctuating soul stabilized again.
And all this took only a short breath.
Kentau's resurrection has not yet been completed, and Chu Xia has regained his fighting strength.
A cold smile appeared on the corner of his mouth, his legs suddenly exerted force, and his whole body shot towards Kentau's reuniting particle group like a meteor.
The Ice Abyss Sword lay in front of him, and the ice-blue light on the sword's edge lit up again.
This time, he must interrupt Kentau's resurrection!
However, just when Chu Xia was about to rush in front of the particle swarm, an extremely thick dark red light pillar fell from the sky and hit Chu Xia's head directly.
That was not a world-destroying thunder catastrophe, but a purer and more terrifying Heavenly attack - the Heavenly Source Light Pillar.
The power of heaven contained in the light pillar is so rich that it cannot be described in words. Every ray of light is a breath of heaven, and every beat is the birth and death of the law.
The moment the light beam fell, Chu Xia felt as if she was being hit head-on by the whole world, and her whole body was blasted straight from the air to the ground by the light beam.
boom!
Chu Xia's body hit the bottom of the pit heavily, creating a bottomless human-shaped hole on the ground.
He struggled to get up, but the beam of light from the source of heaven did not dissipate, but continued to bombard his body.
The power of heaven contained in the light beam was like countless sharp blades, cutting continuously on the surface of his body, and the bones were visible with every cut.
The starlight of the Shining Stars Suit is flashing crazily, and the ten thousand times defense blessing is operating to the limit, but it still cannot completely offset the damage of the original light beam of heaven.
The flesh and blood on Chu Xia's body was continuously peeled off under the bombardment of the light beam, revealing the white bones underneath.
Dense cracks appeared on the surface of the bones, and faint starlight shone through the cracks. That was the shining star suit trying its best to maintain his vitality.
Click!
There was a crisp cracking sound.
Chu Xia's left arm bones finally couldn't bear the continuous bombardment of the Heavenly Dao Light Pillar and broke into two pieces in the middle.
The broken bones pierced the skin and flesh, revealing a sharp section. The bone marrow on the section had been evaporated by the power of heaven, showing a grayish white color.
Chu Xia groaned, veins popped up on her forehead, but her teeth clenched tighter.
His right arm still held the Ice Abyss Sword tightly and did not let go.
At this moment——
A slender, white, perfect jade hand like a work of art suddenly stretched out from behind Chu Xia.
The hand was raised lightly, and its slender fingers were gently grasped in the void.
That's an elegant moveAnd calmly, with an indescribable lazy charm, as if he was just brushing away a fallen leaf falling in front of him.
But with this light grasp, the Heavenly Source Light Pillar, which was terrifying enough to destroy the ninth-order peak ruler in an instant, exploded as if it was pinched by an invisible big hand.
After the light beam exploded, it turned into countless fine fragments of heaven. The fragments scattered in the air, blooming brightly like fireworks.
